summary: New idiom: marḏ̣ele/marḏ̣e u naqdo 'den Brautpreis bezahlen'

data.turoyo: Gəzzən gmarḏ̣ən u naqdo, yaʕni bu tərki kəmmile bašliq, ksaymi musaʕada ʕam babe di kaččəke, kəbilənne əšmo d kallat.
data.translation: Sie bezahlen den Brautpreis, auf Türkisch nennt man es başlık. Sie unterstützen damit den Vater des Mädchens, sie geben ihnen etwas Geld.

rationale: Single clear nominal collocation with bride-price object; search naqdo found only mhr 1 explanatory note, no duplicate collocation.

summary: I has an experiencer subject in clear b-constructions (20/9, PrS 41/122); German gefallen reverses the surface orientation. Existing 78/155 translation likewise needs checking, not an invented replacement.
70/240 provides direct evidence for b-NP/l-suffix alternation. Zero nominal and ʕal complements also occur, but suffixes alone cannot separate liking I.1, consent I.2 and selecting I.3.

Consent has d-clauses, b-, ʕal- and ʕam- complements. qaṭəl-shaped Preterit Intransitive can express present or resulting consent, while copular raḏ̣yo/raḏ̣ye predicates are Part act.; feminine forms can be ambiguous.
The two Infectum-wa tokens express prior unwillingness (JTM 5.2/27, second person) and counterfactual dislike (PrS 48/21). No Detransitive paradigm is securely established here.
Bride-price expression is a single clear collocation. Turkish bašliq in its context is evidence of terminology, not proof of borrowing the entire verbal construction.
New examples were selected by distinct source contexts, counting repeated tokens in a shared quotation once. No need to fill already adequately represented ordinary Infectum I.1/I.2 cells.
No new numbered sense. III reconciliation makes parties consent/be satisfied and fits the existing causative sense; it is not a newly established Detransitive.
The reader Part act. I.1 assignment at Jan 2.27/4515 is corrected to I.2. The inherited 24/105 reassignment and I.1 experiencer gloss were already proposed in R1 and are not repeated.
Spelling raḏi/raḏye without the subscript dot is retained in quoted source text; it does not establish another root or stem.
Confirm marḏ̣e u naqdo in JTM 1.3/22: Detransitive finite form, shortened active form, or another construction? No new Detransitive box is proposed.
Confirm the boundary between feminine Preterit Intransitive and Part act. in LuF 2/37,41,44, 90/151 and 115/146, and masculine Part act. raḏ̣yo at 78/155.
Check krəḏ̣yolox (PrS 63/32) and krəḏ̣yallox (PrS 75/138;79/10): first-person contraction or third-person/impersonal orientation? German cannot decide this.
Check PrS 1/50 versus existing prs 4/21, and input 26/107 versus existing 26/104, against edition concordances before changing citations.
70/183 lacks the negation implied by German. Is source groḏ̣inale defective? No example is added.
107/10 and 115/184 have alignment warnings; supplied translations are withheld. Obtain aligned edition spans before quoting.
Confirm unusual segmentation raḏ̣alli, kroḏ̣annowola and printed rəḏ̣̣yat; no silent normalization was made.
Jan 2.27/4508: is marḏayyən an incomplete causative, a 1pl object form or a restart to I raḏyena?
Jan 2.5/1509: parse Hul Aloho, d lə raḏ̣i, lawi and determine its subject. The supplied machine translation alone cannot establish unwillingness of the speaker.
Jan 2.8/1921–1922: confirm local -anwo plural morphology without treating an already supplied R1 box as new.

rationale: In Gefallen finden, Gefallen is a noun and requires a capital G.

summary: The cause of satisfaction can be food or another nonhuman thing; affected people occur as l-suffix or bare noun. This is already represented by the meal example, not a new lexical sense.
Beidseitige Vermittlung und Entschädigung erweitern die Teilnehmerkonstellation von III.1, ohne neue Bedeutung: marḏallan, danach ausdrücklich šayno baynoṯayye.
R1 hatte Infectum-wa bereits eingeführt; Jan ergänzt pluralisches habituelles Einverständnis bei Heiratsvermittlung.
m- markiert das Herkunftsland als Gegenstand der Unzufriedenheit, b- die anderen Länder als Aufenthaltsorte; nicht beide Präpositionen als identisches Komplement ausgeben.
